review.decision: Recognize Antigravity CLI > approval/choice menus, soft-wrapped option continuations, screen-wait radar promotion, and pre-marker pending-ask gating
review.notes: Antigravity CLI renders > 1. ... numbered choices with ↑/↓ Navigate footer chrome and emits no PermissionRequest hook. Require navigation hint chrome below ASCII > selectors so Markdown blockquotes (> 1. ...) never false-positive, join narrow-pane soft-wrapped option continuations, and open HasPendingAsk only for verified screen-wait panes when no non-ask marker exists.

cases.description: Prompt parser and waiting detector recognize Antigravity > approval menus and wrapped narrow-pane options while rejecting Markdown blockquotes
cases.setup: Construct captures of Antigravity command/tool approval menus on both wide and 46-column soft-wrapped mobile screens, Markdown > 1. blockquotes in prose, answered menus above a redrawn composer, and Antigravity project trust startup gates.
cases.action: Run ParseOptions, WaitingOptions, OptionsReplyable, and IsStartupGate across all fixtures.
cases.expected: WaitingOptions and ParseOptions extract all four complete unwrapped Antigravity choices and mark them OptionsReplyable; Markdown blockquotes without menu navigation chrome and answered menus above a redrawn composer return nil; and Do you trust the contents of this project? matches IsStartupGate for agy.

cases.description: Radar, digest, and server pending-ask gate promote Antigravity screen approval menus to waiting immediately and clear back to working or idle once answered
cases.setup: Simulate a live Antigravity tmux pane with an active PreInvocation turn marker transitioning into a Run this command? screen menu (before and after slow-tick marker persistence) and then returning to running/idle output.
cases.action: Evaluate GatherAgents, GatherDigest, ScreenWaitKind, and hasPendingAsk across pre-marker screen wait, startup/draft markers, and post-answer screen transitions.
cases.expected: GatherAgents and GatherDigest report status waiting with kind permission and replyable Ask options immediately; hasPendingAsk returns true for the live screen-wait pane before slow-tick writes waiting/<pane> while keeping startup, draft, and empty markers false; and clearing the menu immediately restores working or idle.
